Why Choose Flexible Copper Busbar?

Compare our advanced flexible electrical busbar technology with traditional solutions

Traditional Cable

Multiple cable runs with complex connections

  • Current CapacityMultiple units required for high current
  • Heat ManagementUneven current flow causes hot spots
  • InstallationComplex multi-splicing and bulky setup
  • Space EfficiencyLarge installation volume required
  • Cost EfficiencyMore copper usage, higher material cost

Compact Busbar

Factory pre-assembled rigid busbar system

  • Installation FlexibilityFactory pre-assembly required, limited changes
  • Temperature Performance70°C limit, capacity reduces to 15%
  • Emergency BackupCannot restore power supply quickly
  • Energy EfficiencyHigh line loss over 20%
  • Space RequirementsTakes up significant installation space
Recommended

Flexible Copper Busbar

Advanced flexible electrical busbar solution for modern electrical systems

  • High Current Capacity200-6300A single copper busbar unit, no derating needed
  • Superior Heat ManagementConsistent electrical busbar resistance, minimal heat generation
  • Easy InstallationCompact copper busbar size, simple T-connector system
  • Space OptimizationNeat, adaptable electrical busbar shape saves installation space
  • Cost SavingsHigh density copper busbar design reduces material usage
